definitions.explanation: Making fun of oneself or putting oneself down, often for humorous effect. Can also refer to a broader tendency toward self-punishment or self-criticism.

examples.japanese: {自虐|じぎゃく}ネタで{笑|わら}いを{取|と}る。
examples.english: To get laughs with self-deprecating humor.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{自虐|じぎゃく}{的|てき}な{発言|はつげん}が{面白|おもしろ}い。
{自虐|じぎゃく}もほどほどにしないと、{本当|ほんとう}に{自信|じしん}がなくなるよ。
examples.english: If you don't keep the self-deprecation in check, you'll actually lose confidence.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自虐|じぎゃく}ネタ: self-deprecating joke/material
- {自虐|じぎゃく}{的|てき}: self-deprecating, masochistic
- {自虐|じぎゃく}{史観|しかん}: masochistic view of history (political term)

USAGE NOTES:
In modern colloquial usage, {自虐|じぎゃく} most often refers to self-deprecating humor. {自虐|じぎゃく}ネタ is extremely common in Japanese comedy and everyday conversation.
